result.post_merge_correction: The initial attribution of the recursive-member non-determinism to hash-seed dependence in the bounded synthesis search was wrong and has been corrected in the durable records (PR 245 body; continuation state). An adversarially verified read-only code sweep (11 agents; 5 candidate sites refuted, 2 confirmed) established the actual mechanism: per-process entropy (uuid4-derived fresh_engine_run_ids via src/continual/store.py:26-27, plus wall-clock-timestamped trial ledger bytes) enters the iterated-expansion report digest at src/agi/evidence_frontier_iterated_expansion.py:399, and src/agi/recursive_evidence_frontier_growth.py:61,72 folds that unstable digest into the history commitment, which salts support-input rotation, variant-constant selection, and schedule ordering, so the first-two-unsupported scan selects different targets on every run. This violates the commitment's own stable-semantics docstring; the compliant contrast is src/agi/evidence_derived_target_synthesis.py:45-70. Commit message 553b46b retains the superseded wording as a historical record; module/test docstring corrections are assigned to the follow-up unit that fixes the mechanism.
